subject: Observability add-ons — volume tiers, discount schedule & SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@brightforward.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightforward.com
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Observability add-ons — provisional pricing request

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the advanced dashboards and trace sampling look really promising for our SRE and data teams. Procurement asked me to loop you in with a clear ask: we need a formal view of how you price the observability add-ons (longer retention, tracing ingest, and the advanced dashboard bundle), plus the discount schedule tied to committed spend.

Specifically, finance would like to see:
- A simple per-unit list price for: retention storage (GB-month), trace ingest (per 1M spans), and dashboard seats/instances.
- Volume tiers (eg: 0-5TB, 5-25TB, 25TB+) with associated % discounts.
- Any minimums or annual commitments required to access the deeper discounts.
- Clarification on SLAs for the observability components (data retention guarantees, export options, and RTO/RPO if we exceed quota).

We have an internal target to decide on add-on commitments by mid-December. I've attached a short RFQ that procurement uses to collect the numbers. Can you complete the pricing columns and send back?

Attachment: RFQ_BrightForward_Addons_20261201.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Best,
Alex Monroe
Director of Engineering, BrightForward
alex.monroe@brightforward.com
+1 (415) 555-0192
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@brightforward.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons — provisional pricing request

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We've filled the RFQ with list prices and an initial tiered schedule (see attached CSV) and included a couple of commercial options so your procurement team can compare. High level notes up front:

- List prices (examples):
  • Retention storage: $0.12 per GB-month (standard); long-term cold tier: $0.03 per GB-month
  • Trace ingest: $1.80 per 1M spans (sampled)
  • Advanced dashboards bundle: $950 per instance / month (includes 10 team seats + alerting)

- Volume discount model: tiered % off list tied to committed monthly average usage (CMAU).
  • 10% off for CMAU >= $7.5k/month
  • 20% off for CMAU >= $25k/month
  • 30% off for CMAU >= $75k/month

- Commit terms: discounts above require a 12-month add-on commitment (monthly billing). We can also do a 24-month term for an extra 5% off the discounted price.

- SLA / operational notes: observability storage is replicated across two regions for your account by default; retention durability SLA is 99.99% for standard retention. Exports (S3/GCS) are supported for all retention tiers and available on request — export egress is billed separately.

I've copied Vivek (SE) to confirm the technical side of retention/export and to help size expected ingest based on your sample traces. Marissa is on the thread for commercial approval.

Attachments: redwood-observability-pricing-worksheet-20261202.csv

Would you be able to share a 6-week forecast of expected retention GBs and average traces per minute? That will let us map you into the right tier and show the net ARR impact with discounts.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call later this week if useful.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
From: procurement@brightforward.com
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@brightforward.com>
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — provisional pricing request

On Wed, Dec 2, 2026 at 10:05 AM Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> I've copied Vivek (SE) to confirm the technical side of retention/export and to help size expected ingest based on your sample traces.

Neha — thanks, that breakdown helps. A couple of follow-ups from procurement and finance:

1) We are evaluating two scenarios: a conservative 12-month commit (expected CMAU ~$9k/mo) and a growth scenario with a 12–18 month runway where CMAU hits ~$35k/mo. For the growth scenario, finance would like to see a deeper discount band between 20% and 30% (ie a 25% mid-band at ~$35k/mo). Can you provide a firm price at that point?

2) Does Redwood offer any onboarding/implementation credit for the dashboards bundle? Our rollout requires a services window from your solutions team — procurement prefers to net those credits against the first 3 invoices instead of a separate SOW line item.

3) For the SLA: can you confirm retention export RTO (how quickly can we pull a full export) and whether longer retention (>13 months) is supported for compliance archives?

If you can provide a concise commercial response (numbers + a short note on credits/SLA) by EOD Tuesday, we'll put a recommendation to our leadership team on Wednesday.

procurement@brightforward.com
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: procurement@brightforward.com, Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@brightforward.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 8 Dec 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Observability add-ons — provisional pricing request

Hi Alex / procurement team — quick commercial summary and our best offer given your two scenarios. Vivek and Marissa are copied for technical and commercial sign-off.

Offer (net prices shown as a % off list):
- Conservative scenario (CMAU ~$9k/mo): 15% off list for add-ons with a 12-month commitment.
- Growth scenario (CMAU ~$35k/mo): we can commit to a 25% discount band on add-ons with a 12-month commit and a short commercial amendment. If you sign a 24-month term we can move to 30% off.

Additional terms and clarifications:
- Onboarding credit: we can provide a one-time $10k services credit applied across the first three invoices (nets against MRR) — this covers setup, dashboard templates, and two SE days for rollout.
- Retention exports and long-term retention: we support exports to S3/GCS with an export RTO target of 24 hours for full-bucket requests under usual load; for very large archives we plan and schedule exports (may be longer by mutual agreement). Longer retention (>13 months) is supported on our cold tier; pricing provided in the attached worksheet.
- SLA: Observability storage durability 99.99% (standard). For enterprise customers we can discuss an SLA addendum that includes accelerated support response times and a funded runbook for export-driven compliance exercises.

Next steps: if this matches what finance needs, Marissa can draft a commercial amendment for DF-4821 and I can share the updated worksheet with net pricing. Could you confirm which scenario you prefer (conservative vs growth) by Friday 12/11? If helpful, we can do a 30-minute call Thurs to finalize.

Attachments: redwood-observability-pricing-worksheet-20261202.csv

Thanks — Neha
